summary: Alpha Modus Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the September 30, 2026 close of a PIPE transaction, not a special-situation event under standard categories. The company issued 51,621,560 Class A shares and warrants for an additional 51,621,560 shares at a $4.36 exercise price to non-U.S. investors, receiving 3,170 bitcoin valued above $250 million at roughly $83,612 per coin. Proceeds sit in AMOD Tech Pte. Ltd., a new Singapore subsidiary. The filing also updates Nasdaq compliance, following an April 6, 2026 deficiency notice. Watch bitcoin price volatility and potential warrant overhang.
